scope_limits: Finite-dimensional complex quantum structure, complete original instruments and a fixed accepted finite tree are explicit physical inputs.
The Lean source-tree interpreter uses uniform finite carriers and one fixed fallback per tree; node-dependent fallback is a paper consequence of the same local identity.
Allowed-library convex-hull criteria distinguish full maps, support-restricted maps and prescribed reachable inputs; the local criteria are not a universal iff for all terminal-only simulators.
All-input deterministic normalization classification and the external-reference exception are paper proofs with exact finite controls; they classify the prescribed initialization map.
The finite retry-cost recurrence is in Lean; identification with an infinite iid trial-space expectation is a paper monotone-convergence argument requiring fresh preparation.
The Kraus norm sufficient defect bound and spectral-gap perturbation constants are paper results; exact examples and floating diagnostics do not certify a general eigensolver.
No new hardware data, complete natural theory, fundamental complex-sector selection, unrestricted coherent controller or unbounded-time conditioning is claimed.
